lyrics:
[Verse]
Nearer my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee,
Even though it be a cross,
That raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be -
Nearer my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee.

[Verse]
Though, like a wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone,
Yet in my dreams I'd be -
Nearer my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee.

[Verse]
There let the way appear,
Steps unto heaven,
All that Thou sendest me,
In mercy given
Angels to beckon me -
Nearer my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee.
